candidates.name: Austin Restroom Partitions (Breakthrough General Contractors)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists restroom partition and bathroom stall installation, repair and hardware replacement as a Division 10 sub on commercial builds, tenant finish-outs and renovations in Austin.
red_flags: Free Gmail address instead of a company domain
No reviews, ratings or license/registration shown on the site
Only one photo, not identified as a completed project; single testimonial
Trades under a different name (Breakthrough General Contractors)
candidates.reason: Its own site says it installs and repairs restroom partitions for commercial work in Austin and says it is an installer, not a dealer. A thin web presence means vetting (insurance, references, City of Austin contractor registration) matters.

license.name: Austin Restroom Partitions (Breakthrough General Contractors)
license.registry: City of Austin Building and Trade Contractor Services (BTCS) contractor registration; no public lookup
license.note: Texas has no state license for partition installation. Austin requires contractors to register with BTCS before a building permit is issued. The city's registration page (https://austintexas.gov/page/contractor-registration) describes the AB+C account and Jotform registration process but has no public search or list of registered contractors. Searched the City of Austin Issued Construction Permits open data (data.austintexas.gov dataset 3syk-w9eu) for contractor names containing 'BREAKTHROUGH': no permits found. That dataset mostly lists permit holders, so a subcontractor working under a GC's permit may not appear. Registration status unknown; confirm with BTCS by phone or ask the installer for its AB+C registration.
